title: 第18章 二级精铁第19章 入股

第十八章 二级精铁
绚丽的金属火花终于停止，后院的铁匠学徒们一个个仿佛中了石化魔法，呆立在原地仿佛看魔族一样看着乾劲，这是哪里冒出来的小子啊？一百多斤的锤子，他抡起来一口气砸了两百锤子，把一块人头大小的铁胚，生生给砸成了婴孩拳头大小？
一百斤的锤子两百锤啊！弗兰林铁匠铺除了弗兰林能做到之外，便是连弗兰西也不过能砸三十锤，其他人连用都无法使用的锤子，一个刚刚进门的男孩就做到了？而且，最扯的还是这年轻人的身份，奥克兰魔法与战士学院的战士学员？那个只能教出杀魔族的学院，竟然走出了一个会打铁的人？而且一出就是一个看起来像弗兰林老板一样厉害的人？要知道，弗兰林那可是大陆公认的一级铁匠啊！
说句不好听的，弗兰林如果收拾行头跑去魔族那边，那些吃人不吐骨头的魔族，也一样会给予他足够的礼遇，任由他在那里开商铺，甚至还可以给予免税政策，绝对不会像对待普通人类一样，随随便便就杀掉了。
弗兰林轻垫着脚步走到铁砧前，小心的拿起那被乾劲用凉水降温的铁块，跟在身后的弗兰西发出一声类似哨子的倒吸凉气声音，手掌微微有些颤抖的摸向弗兰林手中那块闪耀着异样光芒的铁块。
“大……大哥……这……这是……”
弗兰西双手捧着这小小的铁块，左右仔细的端详，最后激动的看向矮小的弗兰林，发现这位平日里很自信的兄长，如今眼睛中也闪耀着无与伦比的震惊。
“没错……是精铁……”弗兰林吃力的点头：“而且……还是二级精铁……”
死静的打铁铺后院，发出一连串惊呼，铁匠学徒们眼睛里只剩下不可思议的震惊，相互交头接耳的低声说着：“精铁？听到没有？老板说那是精铁！”
“我听到了啊！而且还是二级精铁！”
“天啊！我没听错吧？老板说过的，凡是可以将铁胚敲打出一级精铁的铁匠，那就是真正的一级铁匠了！只有二级铁匠，才能够将铁胚敲打出二级精铁啊！这可是铁匠升级考试必定要做的考验啊。”
“老板打了这么多年铁，拜访名师才成为了一级铁匠，这小子才多大啊？二级铁匠？”
“我说，老板不会看错了吧？这可是奥克兰魔法与战士学院的学生啊。他们不是除了战斗外，什么都不行的一帮人吗？”
“你问我，我怎么知道？就算大老板一个人看错，难道二老板也会看错？别忘记，二老板的打铁水准比不上大老板，但是那双眼睛毒着咧。”
乾劲将打铁锤放在地面，连连活动着酸软的胳膊，这一百来斤的锤子，一口气抡两百下也还是会累人的啊。
二级精铁！弗兰林抓过弗兰西手中的精铁左右观看，心中再次确定这就是一块二级精铁！是真正的打铁高手，将铁中的杂质锤炼出来的二级精铁！
弗兰西看着乾劲心中连连高呼捡到宝了，这世上想要锻造上乘的兵器，就必须要有好的原材料，真正的天材地宝又有多少？经过无数年的铁匠前辈钻研，终于发现了自己制作上等材料的方式，那就是锤炼！
将一块再普通不过的铁胚，铜胚或者其他材料，用打铁锤一点点锻造成为精铁，铜精，根据其程度的不同又分一级吗，二级，三级……越是高级的精铁铜精，制作出的武器，理论上不论坚硬程度还是锋利程度都会越好。
通常，因为精铁等精华材料难得，很多上好武器只有锋刃处是由精铁制作，其主体还是普通的材料，即使这样也同样能卖出上好的价格。
二级精铁？乾劲听到众人的窃窃私语，把自己给吓了一跳，以前在家族中时，也听说过关于精铁的东西，那都是只有真正的铁匠才能锻造出的上等材料！自己随便敲打两下，竟然就砸出了精铁？而且还是二级精铁？

乾劲顿时出了一身冷汗，心中暗暗怪叫：那叫做【无尽世界】虚拟游戏的玩意，到底什么东西？在里面被虐待了十六个小时的打铁游戏，出来之后竟然真的会打铁了！而且还是二级精铁？拥有二级铁匠能力了？这么说，我若是天天泡在里面打铁，是不是哪天我就可以成为神匠大师了？就算是血脉战士见了我，也同样要恭敬静静的称呼我一声大师？
弗兰林来到乾劲面前，心中多少有些难以压制，手中拿早已经凉下来的二级精铁好似依然滚烫，二级精铁！就是二级铁匠！这年轻人，短短的时间就砸出了一块二级精铁，比传闻中二级铁匠考试时用的时间少太多太多，显然不是一个刚刚进阶的二级铁匠。
“您……真的是……奥克兰魔法与战士学院的学员？”弗兰林小心的询问着，不知不觉间将称呼由你变成了您。
乾劲活动着因为长时间紧握打铁锤，有些僵直的十指点了点头：“是啊。”
“那……您真的打算在我们小店打铁？”弗兰林态度变得比之前更谨慎，这二级铁匠的身份，完全有资格轻易在奥克兰开一家属于自己的铁匠铺，这小子不会是来砸场子的吧？
“难道我来贵铁匠铺绣花？”
“可您是二级铁匠啊。”弗兰林略带但有的偷看着乾劲：“小店的经济能力，恐怕还真的无法担负起您薪水，我也不过是一个一级铁匠。”
弗兰西眼睛中的狂喜也变成了担忧，整个奥克兰也所有的铁匠铺，也仅仅只有最大的那家神锤铁匠铺，有一名二级铁匠，自己这店虽然也有些日子家底，但要请一名二级铁匠，恐怕还真的会非常吃力。

Chapter 18 Second Grade Fine Iron
The brilliant metal sparks finally stopped. The blacksmith apprentices in the backyard seemed to be under petrification magic. They stood there blankly and looked at their energy as if they were watching demons. Where did this kid come from? He swung a hammer weighing more than a hundred kilograms and smashed two hundred hammers at once, smashing a piece of iron embryo the size of a human head into a piece the size of a baby's fist?
A hammer weighing one hundred kilograms costs two hundred hammers! In addition to what Flanlin can do in Flanlin's blacksmith shop, even Francie can only smash thirty hammers. No one else can even use the hammer. How can a boy who just entered the door do it? Moreover, the most ridiculous thing is this young man's identity, a warrior student from Oakland Magic and Warrior Academy? That academy that could only teach demon-slayers actually came out with a man who knew how to blacksmith? And when he comes out, he appears to be a man who looks as powerful as Boss Flanlin? You know, Franlin is recognized as a first-class blacksmith in the mainland!
To put it bluntly, if Franlin packs up and goes to the demon clan, those demon clan who eat people without spitting out bones will still give him enough courtesy, let him open a shop there, and even give him a tax-free policy. They will never kill him casually like ordinary humans.
Franlin walked lightly to the anvil, and carefully picked up the iron block that had been cooled with cold water. Francie, who was following behind him, let out a whistle-like gasp, and touched the iron block in Franlin's hand that shone with a strange light with a slightly trembling hand.
"Big...brother...this...this is..."
Francie held the small piece of iron in both hands, looked at it carefully from side to side, and finally looked at the short Franlin excitedly, and found that the usually confident brother now had unparalleled shock in his eyes.
"That's right...it's fine iron..." Flanlin nodded laboriously: "And...it's still second-grade fine iron..."
A series of exclamations erupted from the deadly silent backyard of the blacksmith shop. The blacksmith apprentices only had incredible shock in their eyes, whispering to each other: "Fine iron? Did you hear that? The boss said that is fine iron!"
"I heard it! And it's still level 2 fine iron!"
"Oh my God! Did I hear it right? The boss said that any blacksmith who can knock out iron embryos into first-level fine iron is a real first-level blacksmith! Only a second-level blacksmith can knock out iron embryos into second-level fine iron! This is a test that must be taken in the blacksmith upgrade exam."
"My boss has been making iron for so many years, and he only became a first-class blacksmith after visiting famous masters. How old is this guy? A second-class blacksmith?"
"I said, the boss is not wrong, right? These are students from the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors. Aren't they a group of people who can do nothing but fight?"
"You ask me, how do I know? Even if the big boss is wrong alone, can the second boss also be wrong? Don't forget, the second boss's blacksmithing skills are not as good as the big boss, but his eyes are poisonous."
Ganjin placed the hammer on the ground and moved his sore arms repeatedly. It would still be tiring to swing a hammer weighing more than a hundred kilograms two hundred times at a time.
Second grade refined iron! Franlin grabbed the fine iron in Francie's hand and looked around, and was once again convinced that this was a piece of second-grade fine iron! He is a real master of blacksmithing, hammering out the impurities in the iron to produce second-grade refined iron!
Francie looked at Gan Jin and shouted in her heart that she had found a treasure. If you want to forge superior weapons in this world, you must have good raw materials. How many real treasures are there? After countless years of study as a senior blacksmith, he finally discovered his own way of making high-quality materials, and that was tempering!
Using a hammer to forge a piece of ordinary iron embryo, copper embryo or other materials bit by bit into refined iron and copper essence, are they divided into first level, second level, third level according to their different levels...the more advanced the refined iron and copper essence, the weapons producedIn theory, the tool will be better regardless of its hardness or sharpness.
Usually, because elite materials such as fine iron are rare, many high-quality weapons only have the edge made of fine iron, and their main body is still an ordinary material. Even so, they can still be sold at a good price.
Second grade refined iron? Ganjin was shocked when he heard everyone's whispers. When he was in the family, he had also heard about fine iron. They were the best materials that only real blacksmiths could forge! Just a few random hits on his own, and he actually broke out fine iron? And it’s still second-grade refined iron?
Gan Jin suddenly broke into a cold sweat, and secretly screamed in his heart: What is that thing called the [Endless World] virtual game? I was tortured in the blacksmithing game for sixteen hours, and after I came out, I actually knew how to blacksmith! And it’s still second-grade refined iron? Do you have the level 2 blacksmith ability? So, if I soak in blacksmithing every day, will I become a master craftsman one day? Even if a bloodline warrior sees me, he still has to respectfully and quietly call me master?
When Franlin came to Ganjin, his heart was somewhat difficult to suppress. The second-grade fine iron that had already cooled down in his hand seemed to be still hot, the second-grade fine iron! It’s a second-level blacksmith! This young man smashed out a piece of second-level fine iron in a short time, which was much shorter than the rumored time it took to take the second-level blacksmith exam. He was obviously not a second-level blacksmith who had just advanced.
"Are you...really...a student of the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors?" Franlin asked carefully, unknowingly changing the title from "you" to "you".
He moved vigorously because he had been holding the hammer tightly for a long time, and his fingers were a little stiff and he nodded: "Yes."
"Then...are you really going to blacksmith in our shop?" Flanlin's attitude became more cautious than before. As a second-level blacksmith, he is fully qualified to easily open a blacksmith shop of his own in Auckland. Isn't this guy here to cause trouble?
"Should I come to your blacksmith shop to do embroidery?"
"But you are a second-level blacksmith." Franlin looked at me with a hint of enthusiasm: "I am afraid that the financial capacity of this small shop really cannot afford your salary. I am only a first-level blacksmith."
The ecstasy in Francie's eyes turned to worry. Of all the blacksmith shops in Auckland, only the largest one, the Hammer Smith, had a second-level blacksmith. Although his shop had some money, it would be very difficult to hire a second-level blacksmith.
